notes: The Hearth Chest on the Great Hearth (the Burning Tower, Tyler 2026-11-14; made bigger, glowing and smoking lane/fix138-hearth-chest-big, Tyler 2026-11-17: 'a big deal to open it'). One generated heavy iron-bound chest, a chain across the lid, the Keepers' sun scorched into it, green light at the seam and in four keyholes; tools/world-art/tower-art.mjs pours the four locks onto each key's soot-dulled metal (LOCKS: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum), lays the fire's light on the iron facing the fire and a glint over the locks, and breathes the seam's green (24-frame idle, 3 s at the town's beat). Its `bump` (8 frames: lid lifted on a stepped line of green, the generated peak held 3 beats, lifted, slammed with a 1 px shake) plays now and then in place of idle 0-7 (src/world/core/ambient.js bumpAt), with its light (hearth_chest_glow) and smoke (hearth_chest_smoke) in step. Class relic (art-budget.js): this sprite only. Placed by the town map's AMBIENT rows on the Hearth's ledge (src/data/world/town/sites.js CHEST_SEAT), its manifest ellipse drawn under it (compose.js ambient shade), and drawn only while the server sends the Tower's section.
